notes: 0.3.41：修「几率性读取失败」。真凶是面板每次刷新都在递归统计整个备份目录——92 份快照 / 4.8 万个文件逐个 stat，实测 7.7 秒，加上远端探测 2.5 秒，整次 /config-sync/status 要 11 秒，前端那一次 fetch 撑不住就报「读取失败」。现在：备份列表只给 名字/时间/插件数/能否还原（体积交给资源管理器）；远端探测缓存 5 分钟、每次最多等 2.5 秒、插件装载时预热；前端 status 带 15 秒超时 + 3 次自动重试。实测中位 0.35 秒（原 8.0 秒）。
notesEn: 0.3.41: fixes the intermittent "read failed". The culprit was the panel re-walking the whole backup folder on every refresh - 92 snapshots / 48k files, stat by stat, 7.7 s, plus a 2.5 s remote probe, pushing /config-sync/status to 11 s so a single front-end fetch did not survive it. Now: the snapshot list shows name / time / plugin count / restorability only (sizes belong in Explorer); the remote probe is cached for 5 minutes, capped at 2.5 s and warmed up when the plugin loads; the front-end status call has a 15 s timeout plus 3 automatic retries. Median measured: 0.35 s (was 8.0 s).
